title: Apply as an artist
subtitle: About 10 minutes · We reply within 3 business days
steps.label: Application steps
status.step: Step {step} of 4 · Saved on this device
status.review: Step 4 of 4 · Nothing is public yet
status.invalid: Not sent · {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} to fix
about.title: About you
about.lead: Churches see your name, act type and city. Your email stays private.
about.name: Full name
about.nameHelp: Or your act’s name, as churches will see it.
about.emailHelp: Private. We send your confirmation here.
music.title: Your music
music.lead: This becomes your public profile. Write it for a pastor deciding who leads their people.
videos.title: Videos
videos.lead: Churches book on what they can see. Upload at least one live video.
videos.videoTitleHelp: 5 to 100 characters, for example “Great Is Thy Faithfulness, acoustic”.
videos.fileHelp: MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 1 GB and 15 minutes. A full song, filmed during a real service if you can.
videos.needTitle: Give the video a title of 5 to 100 characters before you choose the file.
videos.uploadFailed: We couldn’t upload {file}. Check your connection and try again.
price.title: Price and travel
price.lead: Churches only see you on dates you’re free and within your driving distance. You mark dates after you’re approved.
price.priceHelp: Whole dollars from $100 to $20,000. Shown on your ticket as “From {price}”. Zamaro keeps 8% when a church books you.
price.distanceHelp: From {city}, {km} km reaches the churches within about that drive.
references.title: Two church references
references.lead: People who have seen you lead worship, not you and not family. We check both before you’re approved.
references.name: Name
review.lead: Then check everything once. Churches see none of this until you’re approved.
review.name: Name
next.title: After you apply
next.referencesMeta: Two short calls to people who’ve seen you lead.
next.reviewMeta: A real person replies within 3 business days.
next.payoutsMeta: Once approved, so churches can pay your deposit.
next.liveMeta: Mark your free dates and you’re on the lineup.
fine: Free to join. Zamaro keeps 8% when a church books you.
done.lead: Your application is in, and a confirmation is on its way to {email}. We review every one by hand and reply by {replyBy}.
done.timeline.reviewMeta: By {replyBy}: approved, or a clear reason why not.
done.timeline.payouts: Set up payouts, then go live
done.timeline.payoutsMeta: Once approved, connect a bank account. Your profile is published after that.
done.questionsText: Reply to the confirmation email or write to {email}. Quote application {number}.
error.title: We couldn’t send your application
error.text: Nothing was sent. Your answers are kept; try again in a moment.
error.challengeTitle: We couldn’t check that you’re a person
error.challengeText: Try sending again; if it keeps happening, email hello@zamaro.ca.
error.inReviewTitle: You already have an application in review.
error.inReviewText: We’re reviewing the one you sent from {email} and will reply there. Your answers here are kept.
invalid.title: Fix {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} to continue
invalid.name: Enter your name, or your act’s name.
invalid.email: Enter an email address like name@church.ca.
invalid.city: Enter the town you’re based in.
invalid.bio: Write a bio of 100 to 1,500 characters.
invalid.videos: Upload at least one video, and wait for each one to finish.
invalid.price: Enter a “from” price in whole dollars from $100 to $20,000.
invalid.distance: Choose how far you’ll drive, from 20 to 200 km.
invalid.referenceContact: Add a phone number or email so we can reach {name}.
invalid.referenceContactNamed: Add a phone number or email so we can reach {name}.
invalid.referenceSelf: References must be someone other than you.
